TS002 function-too-long

A function fits in 70 lines, so that one screen holds the whole unit of work.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "There's a sharp discontinuity between a function fitting on a screen, and having to scroll to see how long it is. For this physical reason we enforce a hard limit of 70 lines per function."
NASA P10 Rule 4: "No function should be longer than what can be printed on a single sheet of paper in a standard reference format with one line per statement and one line per declaration. Typically, this means no more than about 60 lines of code per function."
